waivers.reason: The handheld scanners are plant-floor devices that push scan events over gRPC, and no clock reader exists for a device of that kind: the module cannot declare how their clocks are read. Waived with admin privileges until a reader exists.
No module ships a roles file yet: the roles file has no FxTS spec to be written against, and the hub still uses its own flat roles.
The record id rule of the transport contract (T-5) is not built: records carry an id the adapter makes, and the hub does not yet keep each id once.
Store and forward is not part of the module SDK yet (T-6): the module does not buffer what it cannot deliver.
The goodbye and the last will of the transport contract (T-8) are not built: the hub learns of a shutdown only when calls stop.

metadata.state: Forge's own module for handheld scanning: it runs the gRPC server the scanner devices connect to, turns scan events into records and routes them to the warehouse and inventory modules by scan type. The devices are plant-floor equipment, not third-party software.
metadata.target: A Go module built from the module SDK, with Python scripting for customization (owner, 2026-11-18). Its source path, language and template change in this spec when that code exists.
metadata.time_contract_state: The scanners' clocks are not read: the FACTS spec names no clock-read method for them, because none exists for a device that pushes over gRPC (FB-117). M-3 is waived for that, which counts only once the owner approves this spec. M-4, M-5 and M-7 are run by the conformance kit; M-6 has no sample events.
